(2) Spun off from Armstrong World Industries, Inc. on April 1, 2016, and taken over by Armstrong Flooring, Inc.; later, some of the relevant assets were acquired by AHF Products, with the transaction completed on July 25, 2022.

(3) Standard Square Sizes: 12 × 12 inches (305 × 305 mm); Thicknesses: 1/8 inch (3.2 mm), 3/32 inch (2.4 mm); Product Standard: ASTM F1066; Grade: Class 2; Construction Type: Through Pattern.

(4) Functional Unit: 1 m² of installed flooring, total thickness 3.2 mm; Assumed Building Service Life: 75 years; City of Production: Kankakee, Illinois, USA; Primary Mineral Raw Material: North American limestone, accounting for up to 85% of the total product mass.

# Detailed Simulated Retrieval Trajectory · 8-2-G01

## Step 01 · Decompose the question and establish fields to verify

**Action:** Record required fields for each sub-question according to the current prompt; first identify the bridge entity from the input image, then map each answer field to a verifiable source.

**Evidence Observation:**

I am organizing material archives for a community hall that has been in use for many years. Please answer the following questions based on the flooring material shown in the attachment.

1. To which product family does the flooring material in the image belong? What is the complete series name?
2. When was this flooring business spun off from the original company, and which company took it over after the spin-off? Which company later acquired the relevant assets, and when was the transaction completed?
3. Please list the standard square sizes (imperial and metric) for this series, the two officially provided thicknesses, and the corresponding product standard, grade, and construction type.
4. Please transcribe the following from the official Environmental Product Declaration (EPD) covering this series:
   - The functional unit (the baseline product quantity used for calculating environmental impact) and the corresponding total thickness;
   - The assumed building service life used for calculating environmental impact;
   - The city of production;
   - The name of the primary mineral raw material and the maximum percentage it accounts for of the total product mass.

Answer Format: Please answer in points numbered (1) through (4). Each point should only answer the corresponding sub-question and provide all information required by that question.

**Evidence Links:**

Current prompt and input attachment; this step introduces no external web pages.

**Result of this step:** The retrieval path unfolds according to these sub-questions; the image serves as the object entry point, while numbers, dates, statistics, and status must be read from corresponding records.

## Step 02 · Establish product family candidates using packaging and patterns

**Action:** Example query: Armstrong Imperial Texture Standard Excelon VCT old box; compare official series images and old box candidate sources.

**Evidence Observation:**

The old box and square-tile pattern in the input point the search toward Armstrong commercial VCT. Retail images and the box shown in the auction listing provide visual leads, but cannot by themselves establish the business spin-off history or environmental data for the material. A recorded 403 response from an old eBay page must not be reported as a successful page retrieval.

**Evidence Links:**

https://the-loading-dock-inc.myshopify.com/products/armstrong%C2%AE-commercial-vct-tile-various-colors
https://www.ebay.com/itm/197738339619
https://www.bidmetzger.com/auctions/17953/lot/238255-9-boxes-Armstrong-Tile-imperial-texture-45sq-ft-per-box
https://the-loading-dock-inc.myshopify.com/cdn/shop/products/VCTgreyblue.jpg?v=1687872463

**Result of this step:** Confirm names in the official product catalog.

## Step 03 · Confirm family and complete series

**Action:** Enter the Standard Excelon Imperial Texture page from the official Vinyl Composition Tile category.

**Evidence Observation:**

VCT is the vinyl composition tile family; the complete series name is Standard Excelon Imperial Texture. The trademark Armstrong cannot replace the series name, nor should Imperial Texture be mistakenly attributed to the ceramic tile or AWI ceiling business.

**Evidence Links:**

https://www.armstrongflooring.com/commercial/en-us/products/vinyl-composition-tile.html
https://www.armstrongflooring.com/commercial/en-us/products/vinyl-composition-tile/std-excelon-imp-texture.html

**Result of this step:** Part 1 family and series completed.

## Step 04 · Distinguish between the original company and the spun-off business

**Action:** Review AWI About and Armstrong Flooring 2016 Form 10-K.

**Evidence Observation:**

The 10-K states the spin-off from Armstrong World Industries occurred on 2016-04-01; resilient and wood flooring were taken over by Armstrong Flooring Inc., while AWI retained the ceiling business. The current AWI website positioning is only cross-referential; the legal spin-off time relies primarily on SEC documents.

**Evidence Links:**

https://www.armstrong.com/en-us/about-us.html
https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1655075/000165507517000003/afi10-k123116.htm

**Result of this step:** Part 2 first stage 2016-04-01 and AFI confirmed.

## Step 05 · Track the scope of the 2022 asset transaction

**Action:** Read the AHF Products press release regarding the acquisition of part of Armstrong Flooring's assets.

**Evidence Observation:**

The buyer obtained relevant partial assets, three US factories, and brand licensing arrangements; "partial assets" cannot be expanded to mean the acquisition of the entire Armstrong World Industries. The news page header July 5 conflicts with legal closing data, so the date must be verified separately.

**Evidence Links:**

https://www.ahfproducts.com/en-us/press/ahf-products-completes-purchase-of-certain-assets-of-armstrong-flooring.html

**Result of this step:** Acquirer AHF Products confirmed; closing date pending SEC verification.

## Step 06 · Determine completion date using statutory disclosures

**Action:** Enter AFI 2022-07-29 Form 8-K and locate Item 2.01.

**Evidence Observation:**

This item states the North American asset transaction was completed on 2022-07-25; joint buyers involved AHF, LLC and Gordon Brothers; the prompt's brand flooring successor uses AHF Products, and the completion date uses July 25. Do not mistakenly take July 5 from the web page header.

**Evidence Links:**

https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1655075/000119312522207314/d343439d8k.htm

**Result of this step:** Part 2 closing date fixed at 2022-07-25.

## Step 07 · Read standard square sizes

**Action:** Check sizes on the official series page, then open F9717-924 Standard Excelon Product Specification.

**Evidence Observation:**

Standard square specification 12×12in, metric 305×305mm. Packaging may include area per box, but 45sqft per box etc. are not single-tile sizes; list imperial and metric according to official rounded values, do not arbitrarily change to 304.8mm which conflicts with the page.

**Evidence Links:**

https://www.armstrongflooring.com/commercial/en-us/products/vinyl-composition-tile/std-excelon-imp-texture.html
https://www.armstrongflooring.com/cdn/datasheets/afi/F9717-924_StdExcSpecPg.pdf

**Result of this step:** Part 3 sizes consistent in both units.

## Step 08 · Verify two thicknesses and grade

**Action:** Check gauge, standard, and construction fields on the product page and specification PDF item by item.

**Evidence Observation:**

Thicknesses 1/8in (3.2mm) and 3/32in (2.4mm); standard ASTM F1066, Class 2, Through Pattern. Class 2 is a product standard classification, not a fire resistance rating; Through Pattern refers to a through-body pattern construction.

**Evidence Links:**

https://www.armstrongflooring.com/commercial/en-us/products/vinyl-composition-tile/std-excelon-imp-texture.html
https://www.armstrongflooring.com/cdn/datasheets/afi/F9717-924_StdExcSpecPg.pdf

**Result of this step:** Part 3 five specification items complete.

## Step 09 · Find the EPD covering this series

**Action:** Example query: Armstrong VCT EPD Imperial Texture Kankakee 75 years; check VCT_EPD_11_26.pdf.

**Evidence Observation:**

The declared product list explicitly includes Standard Excelon Imperial Texture, so it can be used to answer environmental parameters for this series; do not cite LVT or other flooring EPDs from the same manufacturer solely based on manufacturer identity. Save file issue date 2025-10-23; use this version from the prompt package.

**Evidence Links:**

https://www.armstrongflooring.com/cdn/sustainability/afi/VCT_EPD_11_26.pdf

**Result of this step:** Part 4 extracted from the same declaration version.

## Step 10 · Transcribe functional unit and thickness

**Action:** Locate Declared Product and Functional Unit and product specification parameters.

**Evidence Observation:**

Functional unit 1 m² of installed flooring, corresponding total thickness 3.2 mm. The area unit is the baseline quantity for life cycle assessment, not the quantity per box; the EPD adopts the 3.2 mm caliber, which does not mean the series' other 2.4 mm specification does not exist.

**Evidence Links:**

https://www.armstrongflooring.com/cdn/sustainability/afi/VCT_EPD_11_26.pdf

**Result of this step:** Part 4 functional unit and thickness completed.

## Step 11 · Distinguish between construction period and product reference service life

**Action:** Cross-read functional unit and Product RSL on the front page of the EPD.

**Evidence Observation:**

Building service life is 75 years, while Product RSL is listed separately as 25 years. The question asks for the assumed building service life used for calculating environmental impact, so answer 75, do not take the nearer 25-year field; the difference between the two does not constitute a contradiction within the document.

**Evidence Links:**

https://www.armstrongflooring.com/cdn/sustainability/afi/VCT_EPD_11_26.pdf

**Result of this step:** Part 4 modeling service life 75 years.

## Step 12 · Read manufacturing location and mineral percentage

**Action:** Locate EPD production and Product Description sections, transcribe Kankakee and limestone item by item.

**Evidence Observation:**

City of production Kankakee, Illinois, USA; primary mineral North American limestone, accounting for up to 85% of total mass. "Up to" indicates an upper limit; do not write that every color and every batch is exactly 85%, nor mistake the North American raw material origin for the manufacturing city.

**Evidence Links:**

https://www.armstrongflooring.com/cdn/sustainability/afi/VCT_EPD_11_26.pdf
https://www.armstrongflooring.com/commercial/en-us/products/vinyl-composition-tile.html

**Result of this step:** Part 4 factory city and raw material upper limit completed.

## Step 13 · Verify different calibers for dates/specifications/EPD

**Action:** Re-review SEC event dates, current series specifications, and saved EPD parameters in three columns.

**Evidence Observation:**

Do not read company history from retail images, do not infer all SKUs from environmental functional units for specifications, and do not treat the EPD's 75 years as a product warranty life. Use sources and versions corresponding to the prompt questions for all fields, retaining the explanation of the page header date conflict.

**Evidence Links:**

https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1655075/000165507517000003/afi10-k123116.htm
https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1655075/000119312522207314/d343439d8k.htm
https://www.armstrongflooring.com/commercial/en-us/products/vinyl-composition-tile/std-excelon-imp-texture.html
https://www.armstrongflooring.com/cdn/datasheets/afi/F9717-924_StdExcSpecPg.pdf
https://www.armstrongflooring.com/cdn/sustainability/afi/VCT_EPD_11_26.pdf

**Result of this step:** Dependency chain for all four questions closed.

## Step 14 · Check evidence dependencies and answer boundaries

**Action:** Connect obtained bridge entities in dependency order, check each question for number mismatches, changes in time caliber, or presenting inferences as facts.

**Evidence Observation:**

Dependency chain: Old box/square tile → Armstrong commercial VCT/Imperial Texture → SEC spin-off → Asset acquisition closing → Specification PDF → EPD functional unit/service life/factory/mineral.

Boundaries to retain: AHF page July 5 header conflicts with SEC closing July 25; EPD building 75 years differs from product RSL 25 years; asset transaction is not the entire AWI.

**Evidence Links:**

Current prompt and input attachment; this step introduces no external web pages.

**Result of this step:** Each field uses the evidence directly corresponding to it above; organize confirmed conclusions according to the numbering, tables, and units specified in the prompt.

**Action:** Submit the answer with the fields required by the current question.

**Evidence Observation:** Cross-check of objects, sources, and corresponding versions has been completed; previously unconfirmable information is retained.

**Result of this step:**

(1) Product Family: Armstrong Flooring commercial vinyl composition tile (VCT); Complete Series Name: Standard Excelon Imperial Texture.

(2) Spun off from Armstrong World Industries, Inc. on April 1, 2016, and taken over by Armstrong Flooring, Inc.; later, some of the relevant assets were acquired by AHF Products, with the transaction completed on July 25, 2022.

(3) Standard Square Sizes: 12 × 12 inches (305 × 305 mm); Thicknesses: 1/8 inch (3.2 mm), 3/32 inch (2.4 mm); Product Standard: ASTM F1066; Grade: Class 2; Construction Type: Through Pattern.
